Desc.LocalizedString: Shock nearby teammates at the end.

Desc.SourceString: 位于朱厌前方一定范围内时，破盾效率提高<shuzhi>400%</>，受到的伤害降低<shuzhi>30%</>
Desc.LocalizedString: When located within a certain range in front of Zhuyan, increase shatter by <shuzhi>400%</> and reduce damage received by <shuzhi>30%</>.

Desc.SourceString: 造成伤害可叠加层数，每秒至多叠加1层，叠满10层后清空层数并使得造成与受到的伤害提高<shuzhi>200%</>
Desc.LocalizedString: Damage dealt becomes stackable, for a maximum of 1 stack per second. After stacking 10 times, the number of stacks will be cleared, increasing the damage dealt and received by <shuzhi>200%</>.

Desc.SourceString: 心头燃起无名的怒火，每次攻击获得<shuzhi>1</>层怒气，每秒至多获得<shuzhi>1</>层，达到<shuzhi>20</>层时将怒不可遏，短暂时间后震伤附近的队友
Desc.LocalizedString: An unfathomable rage is brewing, each attack gains <shuzhi>1</> stack of rage, gaining up to <shuzhi>1</> stack per second. Upon reaching <shuzhi>20</> stacks, become infuriated, shocking nearby teammates shortly after.

Desc.SourceString: 海拉在生命值降低至一定比例时将开启防御模式，期间海拉不会发动攻击，但拥有一个无敌效果。无敌效果持续期间，空中将出现能量核心并缓慢下落，在这些能量核心掉落至地面前，若角色与其产生接触，将会获得能量核心带来的增益效果，大幅提高角色的跳跃高度、移动速度，并减少角色的耐力消耗。同时，还会对海拉的防御模式造成干扰，当能量核心被夺取多次后，海拉的无敌状态将被提前中止。
Desc.LocalizedString: When Harrah's HP drops to a certain percentage, she enters a defensive mode, launching no attacks and gaining invincibility. During her invincibility period, energy cores appear in the air and slowly descend, which grants them a buff upon contact with Wanderers before landing on the ground, significantly enhancing their jump height and speed and reducing their END consumption. The energy cores also interfere with Harrah's defensive mode. If the energy cores are seized multiple times, Harrah's invincibility state ends prematurely.

Desc.SourceString: 在海拉周围的角色会被叠加火种标记，距离海拉越近，火种标记叠加速度越快，标记最多叠加100层。被叠加超过50层火种标记的角色受到海拉造成的伤害时，会被清空所有火种标记层数，并受到一个基于火种层数的额外伤害。
Desc.LocalizedString: Harrah inflicts Ember marks on the surrounding Wanderers, and the closer they are to Harrah, the faster the marks stack up, up to 100 stacks. Wanderers with more than 50 Ember mark stacks, when damaged by Harrah, will have all their Ember marks cleared and receive additional damage based on the stacks of Ember marks.

Desc.SourceString: 战斗中，海拉将周期性地孵化小灰域体并排出体外，及时摧毁这些小灰域体将移除周围所有角色身上的全部火种标记，并使他们获得持续10s的火种标记免疫效果
Desc.LocalizedString: During combat, Harrah periodically hatches small Grayspace Entities and expels them. Destroy the entities in time to remove all Ember marks from surrounding Wanderers and grant them a 10s immunity to Ember marks.

Desc.SourceString: 在海拉周围的玩家会被叠加极寒标记，标记最多叠加25层。当极寒标记叠加到满层时，目标角色将被冰冻，冰冻持续期间内若受到来自海拉造成的伤害将提前解除冰冻，同时受到一次高额破冰伤害。
Desc.LocalizedString: Harrah inflicts Frosty marks on the surrounding Wanderers, up to 25 stacks. When Frosty marks reach full stacks, the target Wanderer will be frozen. If damaged by Harrah during the freeze, the freeze status is lifted, but the target suffers significant Icebreak damage 1 time.

Desc.SourceString: 战斗中，海拉将周期性地孵化小灰域体并排出体外，及时摧毁这些小灰域体将移除周围所有角色身上的全部极寒标记，并使他们获得持续10s的极寒标记免疫效果
Desc.LocalizedString: During combat, Harrah periodically hatches small Grayspace Entities and expels them. Destroy the entities in time to remove all Frosty marks from surrounding Wanderers and grant them a 10s immunity to Frosty marks.

Desc.SourceString: 角色处于海拉附近或受到来自海拉造成的伤害时，会被叠加威压标记，标记最多叠加50层。每层威压标记将减少角色1%的最大生命值上限，最多减少50%的最大生命值上限。
Desc.LocalizedString: Wanderers near Harrah or taking damage from her will be inflicted with Oppression marks, up to 50 stacks. Each Oppression mark reduces the Wanderer's Max HP by 1%, up to a maximum reduction of 50%.

Desc.SourceString: 战斗中，海拉将周期性地孵化小灰域体并排出体外，及时摧毁这些小灰域体将移除周围所有角色身上的威压标记，并使他们获得持续10s的威压标记免疫效果
Desc.LocalizedString: During combat, Harrah periodically hatches small Grayspace Entities and expels them. Destroy the entities in time to remove all Oppression marks from surrounding Wanderers and grant them a 10s immunity to Oppression marks.

Desc.SourceString: 角色每次受到来自海拉的伤害时，将会被叠加时间扭曲标记，标记最多叠加10层。当时间扭曲标记达到满层时，角色将被施加枯萎效果：持续时间内周期性扣除耐力。
Desc.LocalizedString: Every time a Wanderer takes damage from Harrah, they're also inflicted with the Temporal Distortion marks, up to 10 stacks. When these marks reach full stacks, the character is subjected to the Withering Effect, losing END periodically throughout the duration.

Desc.SourceString: 战斗中，海拉将周期性地孵化小灰域体并排出体外，及时摧毁这些小灰域体将移除周围所有角色身上的枯萎效果，并使他们获得持续10s的时间扭曲标记免疫效果
Desc.LocalizedString: During combat, Harrah periodically hatches small Grayspace Entities and expels them. Destroy the entities in time to remove all Withering Effect from surrounding Wanderers and grant them a 10s immunity to Temporal Distortion marks.

Desc.SourceString: 战斗中，海拉将周期性地降下落雷。当被雷击的角色感电层数小于十层时，受到基于感电层数的雷电伤害，并在伤害后叠加一层感电标记。感电满十层后，被雷击角色将被高电压击穿，从而受到最大生命值120%的致命伤害。
Desc.LocalizedString: During combat, Harrah periodically summons lightning strikes. When a target struck by lightning's Electrify stacks is fewer than 10, they will receive volt damage based on the number of Electrify stacks, then receive 1 Electrify mark. After reaching 10 Electrify stacks, the target struck by lightning is pierced by high voltage, receiving lethal damage equal to 120% of Max HP.

Desc.SourceString: 战斗中，海拉将周期性地孵化小灰域体并排出体外，及时摧毁这些小灰域体将移除周围所有角色身上的全部感电标记，并使他们获得持续10s的感电标记免疫效果
Desc.LocalizedString: During combat, Harrah periodically hatches small Grayspace Entities and expels them. Destroy the entities in time to remove all Electrify marks from surrounding Wanderers and grant them a 10s immunity to Electrify marks.

Desc.SourceString:
<shuzhi>火焰反应</>：装备<shuzhi>2</>把及以上火元素武器触发，提升<shuzhi>20%</>火攻和<shuzhi>40%</>火抗，装备后后台可生效（多个火焰共鸣/火焰反应不叠加，优先生效火焰共鸣）
<shuzhi>火焰恩赐</>：自身激活恩赐共鸣时，提升全队<shuzhi>5%</>火攻
Desc.LocalizedString:
<shuzhi>Flame Resonance</>: Increase flame ATK by <shuzhi>15%</> and flame resistance by <shuzhi>25%</>. Activate by equipping <shuzhi>2</> or more flame weapons. This set effect works in the off-hand slot. Cannot stack with effects of the same type.
<shuzhi>Flame Benediction</>: Increase the entire team's flame ATK by <shuzhi>5%</> when Benediction Resonance is active.

Desc.SourceString:
<shuzhi>火焰共鸣</>：装备<shuzhi>2</>把及以上火元素武器触发，提升<shuzhi>15%</>火攻和<shuzhi>25%</>火抗，装备后后台可生效，同类效果不叠加。
<shuzhi>火焰恩赐</>：自身激活恩赐共鸣时，提升全队<shuzhi>5%</>火攻。
Desc.LocalizedString:
<shuzhi>Flame Reaction</>: Increase flame ATK by <shuzhi>20%</> and flame resistance by <shuzhi>40%</>. Activate by equipping <shuzhi>2</> or more flame weapons. This set effect works in the off-hand slot. Cannot stack with other Flame Resonance or Flame Reaction effects, with Flame Resonance taking precedence.
<shuzhi>Flame Benediction</>: Increase entire team's flame ATK by <shuzhi>5%</> when Benediction Resonance is activated.

Desc.SourceString:
拥有<shuzhi>雀羽</>时，使用武器<shuzhi>松彗</>攻击可向锁定目标发射一枚<shuzhi>雀羽</>，造成伤害，<shuzhi>雀羽</>攻击冷却<shuzhi>1</>秒。
武器<shuzhi>松彗</>处于后台时，使用其他武器攻击也可触发<shuzhi>雀羽</>，<shuzhi>雀羽</>攻击冷却<shuzhi>2</>秒。
<shuzhi>雀羽</>初始数量为<shuzhi>30</>枚，上限为<shuzhi>60</>枚。
Desc.LocalizedString:
When the wielder has a <shuzhi>Sparrow Feather</>, using <shuzhi>Pine Comet</> will launch a <shuzhi>Sparrow Feather</> toward the locked-on target, dealing damage. The <shuzhi>Sparrow Feather</> attack has a <shuzhi>1</>-second cooldown.
When <shuzhi>Pine Comet</> is in the off-hand slot, attacking with other weapons can also trigger <shuzhi>Sparrow Feather</>, with a <shuzhi>2</>-second cooldown for the <shuzhi>Sparrow Feather</> attack.
The initial number of <shuzhi>Sparrow Feathers</> is <shuzhi>30</>, with a maximum capacity of <shuzhi>60</>.

Desc.SourceString: 释放任意火武器连携技均可给锁定目标添加1层”雀燃“，同一个目标最多可叠加2层。
Desc.LocalizedString: Using any flame weapon's discharge skill will apply 1 stack of Sparroburn to the locked-on target, stacking up to 2 times on the same target.

Desc.SourceString: <shuzhi>爆炎-驻场</>：使用武器<shuzhi>松彗</>攻击命中时，每<shuzhi>1.5</>秒造成一次爆炎伤害（爆炎伤害=<shuzhi>{0}%</>*火攻+<shuzhi>{1}%</>*最大生命值+<shuzhi>{2}%</>*抗性之和+<shuzhi>{3}%</>*暴击值），爆炎伤害不受除泰坦装备稀有属性以外的增伤影响且不会触发额外的攻击效果，伤害类型为<shuzhi>普攻</>，若装备的另外<shuzhi>2</>把武器中存在雷电/寒冰/物理武器则爆炎伤害提升至<shuzhi>{4}</>倍。
Desc.LocalizedString: <shuzhi>Fiery Explosion: On-Field</>: When landing a hit with <shuzhi>Pine Comet</>, every <shuzhi>1.5</> seconds, it deals Fiery Explosion damage (Fiery Explosion damage equals to <shuzhi>{0}%</> of flame ATK plus <shuzhi>{1}%</> of Max HP plus <shuzhi>{2}%</> of the sum of all the Wanderer's resistance types plus <shuzhi>{3}%</> of crit). Fiery Explosion damage is not affected by damage boosts, except for titan equipment's rare stats, and won't trigger additional attack effects. The damage is counted as <shuzhi>normal attack</> damage. If there is a volt/frost/physical weapon equipped in the <shuzhi>2</> other weapon slots, Fiery Explosion damage is multiplied by <shuzhi>{4}</> times.

Desc.SourceString: <shuzhi>火焰共鸣</>：装备<shuzhi>2</>把及以上火焰武器触发，提升<shuzhi>20%</>火攻和<shuzhi>40%</>火抗，装备后后台可生效（多个火焰共鸣/火焰反应不叠加，优先生效火焰共鸣）
Desc.LocalizedString: <shuzhi>Flame Resonance</>: Increase flame ATK by <shuzhi>20%</> and flame resistance by <shuzhi>40%</>. Activate by equipping <shuzhi>2</> or more flame weapons. This set effect works in the off-hand slot. Cannot stack with other Flame Resonance or Flame Reaction effects, with Flame Resonance taking precedence.

Desc.SourceString: 受到物攻击时，造成的伤害不会立即结算，而是会形成持续侵蚀的效果：伤害会在一定时间内持续缓慢的释放。在此期间，只能设法延缓或暂停侵蚀，但是无法提前终止或者减少侵蚀的总伤害，除非怪物死亡。
Desc.LocalizedString: When damaged by a physical attack, damage received will not be dealt immediately, but will be converted into a Corrosion effect: Damage is continuously and slowly dealt over a certain period of time. The duration of this effect can be delayed or paused, but the total amount of damage to be dealt cannot be lessened, and the effect cannot end early unless the target is defeated.

Desc.SourceString:
受到来自月星钏的共享效果：
自身激活坚毅共鸣时，获得对方<shuzhi>50%</>全抗，受到来自“月星钏”的治疗量提升<shuzhi>50%</>；
自身激活均衡/强攻共鸣时，获得对方<shuzhi>20%</>攻击（最多不超过<shuzhi>20000</>），受到来自“月星钏”的治疗量提升<shuzhi>50%</>；
自身激活恩赐共鸣时，双方治疗效果提高<shuzhi>30%</>，受到来自“月星钏”的治疗量提升<shuzhi>50%</>。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Moonstar Bracelet's Division effect:
While Fortitude Resonance is active, gain <shuzhi>50%</> of the other Wanderer's all resistance, and increase healing received from Moonstar Bracelet by <shuzhi>50%</>.
When Balance Resonance/Attack Resonance is active, gain <shuzhi>20%</> of the other Wanderer's ATK (up to <shuzhi>20,000</>), and healing received from Moonstar Bracelet is increased by <shuzhi>50%</>.
When Benediction Resonance is active, the outgoing healing effect of both Wanderers is increased by <shuzhi>30%</>, and healing received from Moonstar Bracelet is increased by <shuzhi>50%</>.

Desc.SourceString:
链接一名队友，并与对方共享（超出链接或者其中一方死亡结束），处于链接/被链接状态时，无法再被链接/主动链接。
链接的对方为坚毅共鸣时，会额外传递自身<shuzhi>50%</>抗性给对方，受到来自“月星钏”的治疗量提升<shuzhi>50%</>；
链接的对方为均衡/强攻共鸣时，会额外传递自身<shuzhi>20%</>攻击给对方（最多不超过<shuzhi>20000</>），受到来自“月星钏”的治疗量提升<shuzhi>50%</>；
链接的对方为恩赐共鸣时，双方治疗效果提高<shuzhi>30%</>，受到来自“月星钏”的治疗量提升<shuzhi>50%</>。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Link with an ally to activate the division effect (link ends when its range is exceeded or one of the pair is defeated). When the link is in effect, the pair cannot make a link or be linked again.
When the linked ally activates Fortitude Resonance, an extra <shuzhi>50%</> of resistance is transmitted to the linked ally, and the linked ally's healing received from Moonstar Bracelet is increased by <shuzhi>50%</>.
When the linked ally activates Balance Resonance/Attack Resonance, an extra <shuzhi>20%</> of ATK is transmitted to the linked ally (no more than <shuzhi>20,000</>), and the linked ally's healing received from Moonstar Bracelet is increased by <shuzhi>50%</>.
When the linked ally activates Benediction Resonance, the outgoing healing of the pair is increased by <shuzhi>30%</>, and their healing received from Moonstar Bracelet is increased by <shuzhi>50%</>.

Desc.SourceString: 无法获得充能

Desc.LocalizedString: Unable to gain weapon charge or receive DoT during Phantasia.

Desc.SourceString: 受到电荷磁场的影响，无法释放技能以及切换武器。
Desc.LocalizedString: Unable to use skills or switch weapons when in the magnetic field.

Desc.SourceString: 移动速度提升25%，接触带有正负状态的其他玩家时使其进入消能状态。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increase movement speed by 25%, touching players in a positive or negative current will remove their charge.

Desc.SourceString: 无法普攻，进入游泳状态可以消除此状态。
Desc.LocalizedString: Unable to use normal attacks, swimming can cancel this effect.

Name.SourceString: 负能状态，进入游泳状态可以消除此状态。

Desc.SourceString: 无法释放技能
Desc.LocalizedString: Unable to use skills.

Desc.LocalizedString: A nerve-slowing toxin that does not affect Shelly, deals DoT for 10 seconds. Antibodies can be obtained by exploring the world.

Desc.SourceString: 拯救海洋的英雄，汇聚大家的力量，你！不再畏惧纳克亚的毒素！
Desc.LocalizedString: Savior of the ocean, leader of the masses, you! Fear Nakya's poison no longer!

Desc.SourceString: 根据因子数量提高受到的伤害，且期间内无法被治疗。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases damage received based on the number of anomalies. Unable to receive healing while this skill is active.

Desc.SourceString: 纳克亚的专属阿比斯因子，纳克亚将会操控因子对它的狩猎目标造成影响。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nakya's exclusive Abyssant Anomaly, Nakya controls the Anomaly to affect the target of its hunt.

Desc.SourceString: 累计30层后将会受到伤害，及时转移到”暗“领域减弱效应，但该效应较为不稳定。
Desc.LocalizedString: Receive damage after 30 stacks. Move to the "Dark" Field to reduce its effect, but it's unstable.

Desc.SourceString: 累计30层后将会受到伤害，及时转移到”明“领域减弱效应，但该效应较为不稳定。
Desc.LocalizedString: Receive damage after 30 stacks. Move to the "Light" Field to reduce its effect, but it's unstable.

Desc.SourceString: 获得伤害和减伤提升，持续90秒，死亡后移除
Desc.LocalizedString: Gain damage boost and damage reduction boost for 90 seconds. Removed upon death.

Desc.SourceString: 移动速度提升15%，治疗效果提升30%，复活等待时间减少60%
Desc.LocalizedString: Increase speed by 15% and healing effect by 30%, and reduce resurrection waiting time by 60%.

Desc.SourceString: 使用炮台时伤害提升25%，占领能源塔时读条时间减30%，战斗中可以乘骑载具且不会被击下载具
Desc.LocalizedString: Increase damage by 25% when using turrets. Reduce loading time by 30% when occupying energy towers. Able to ride vehicles during battle and will not be knocked down.

Desc.SourceString: 对怪物的伤害提升45%，并且击杀野怪时获得20点己方进度积分
Desc.LocalizedString: Increase damage against monsters by 45%, and earn 20 progress points when killing a monster.

Desc.SourceString: 攻击力提升10%，生命提升10%
Desc.LocalizedString: Increase ATK by 10% and Health by 10%.

Desc.SourceString: 每次击败玩家获得10%的伤害提升，最多叠加10层，死亡时损失一半的层数，不足1层按1层计算
Desc.LocalizedString: Increase damage dealt by 10% for each player defeated, stacking up to 10 times. Lose half of the stacks upon dying (rounding up).

Desc.SourceString: 周围15米内没有敌方玩家时获得35%的伤害提升;周围15米内没有敌方玩家时，每5秒获得一次50%的伤害提升（最多1层），攻击命中后伤害提升消失
Desc.LocalizedString: When there are no enemy players within 15 meters, increase damage by 35% and increase damage by 50% every 5 seconds (1 stack only, stack fades after a successful attack).

Desc.SourceString: 累积受到自身最大生命值25%的伤害，会对周围12米范围造成2000%攻击的爆炸伤害，并眩晕目标3秒（无视霸体），15秒冷却。自身和自身半径15米内的友方获得15%的减伤
Desc.LocalizedString: After taking accumulated damage equal to 25% of Max HP, deal explosion damage equal to 2,000% of ATK to the area within a 12-meter radius and stun the targets for 3 seconds (ignoring hyperbody). 15-second cooldown. You and allies within 15 meters from you gain 15% damage reduction.

Desc.SourceString: 己方占领的能源站积分获取速度提升50%，并且冻结敌方能源站，不再提供积分。持续60秒
Desc.LocalizedString: Increase the point acquisition speed at your Energy Stations by 50%, and freeze the enemy's Energy Stations so that they do not offer points for 60 seconds.

Desc.SourceString: <shuzhi>火焰共鸣</>：装备<shuzhi>2</>把及以上火焰武器触发，提升<shuzhi>15%</>火攻和<shuzhi>25%</>火抗，装备后后台可生效（多个火焰共鸣/火焰反应不叠加，优先生效火焰共鸣）。
Desc.LocalizedString: <shuzhi>Flame Resonance</>: Increase flame ATK by <shuzhi>15%</> and flame resistance by <shuzhi>25%</>. Activate by equipping <shuzhi>2</> or more flame weapons. This set effect works in the off-hand slot. Cannot stack with other Flame Resonance or Flame Reaction effects, with Flame Resonance taking precedence.

Desc.SourceString: 怪物的攻击拥有强力的灰噬效果。需要避免被击中。
Desc.LocalizedString: Enemy attacks have a powerful Graying Bite effect. Avoid getting hit.

Desc.SourceString: 怪物死亡后会给周围回复100%生命。可通过降低怪物治疗阻止怪物回复。
Desc.LocalizedString: When an enemy is defeated, it restores 100% HP to surrounding enemies. Reduce its healing to prevent the HP recovery.

Desc.SourceString: 每次使用技能提升自身50%最终伤害。最高提升200%，持续4秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increase final damage by 50% every time you use a skill, stacking up to 200% and lasting for 4 seconds.

Desc.SourceString: 怪物被破盾后会立即死亡。推荐使用破盾高的武器。
Desc.LocalizedString: Enemies will be defeated immediately after their shields are shattered. Use a weapon with strong shatter proficiency.

Desc.SourceString: 每次使用普攻提升自身20%最终伤害。最高提升200%，持续2秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increase final damage by 20% every time you use a normal attack, stacking up to 200% and lasting for 2 seconds.

Desc.SourceString: 怪物死亡后会大幅提升周围其他怪物攻击和抗性。尽可能同时击杀怪物。
Desc.LocalizedString: When an enemy is defeated, it will greatly increase the attack and resistance of surrounding enemies. Try to eliminate enemies at the same time.

Desc.LocalizedString: Increase final damage by 40% every time you dodge. Stacking up to 200%, lasting for 5 seconds.

Desc.SourceString: 怪物攻击附带时延效果。推荐使用清除或者免疫时延的武器。
Desc.LocalizedString: Enemy attacks have a delay effect. Use weapons that can remove or are immune to delay.

Desc.LocalizedString: Shield effects of Rumble (Physical-Flame) and Rumble (Volt-Frost) are unavailable in Apex League.

Desc.LocalizedString: Buffs are unable to be gained.

Desc.SourceString: 若受到治疗效果超过生命值上限时会形成生命护盾，生命护盾值不超过最大生命值<ComLblGreen>60%</>
Desc.LocalizedString: An HP shield will be generated if the healing received exceeds the Max HP. The shield's value cannot exceed <ComLblGreen>60%</> of the Max HP.

Desc.SourceString: 成功添加给友方的[宽恕]守护数量，持续<ComLblGreen>25</>秒
Desc.LocalizedString: Quantity of successfully added Forgiveness Guard to allies. Lasts <ComLblGreen>25</> seconds.

Desc.SourceString: 「悔悟」守护，最多可获得<shuzhi>5</>个，持续<shuzhi>25</>秒
Desc.LocalizedString: Obtain up to <shuzhi>5</> Enlightenment Guards, lasting <shuzhi>25</> seconds.

Desc.SourceString: 若自身守护达到最大数量时，刷新守护时间
Desc.LocalizedString: If your Guards are at the maximum, the Guard duration will be refreshed.

Desc.SourceString: 获得<shuzhi>{0}%</>最终伤害提升，持续<shuzhi>{1}</>秒
Desc.LocalizedString: Increase final damage by <shuzhi>{0}%</> for <shuzhi>{1} </>seconds.

Desc.SourceString: 受到致命伤害，消耗<shuzhi>1</>层守护抵挡该次伤害并恢复<shuzhi>{0}%</>最大生命值（巅峰联赛中不生效）
Desc.LocalizedString: Upon taking lethal damage, consume <shuzhi>1</> stack of Guard to negate the damage and recover <shuzhi>{0}%</> of the Max HP. Unavailable in Apex League.

Desc.SourceString: 每个守护提供<shuzhi>{0}%</>的伤害提升和<shuzhi>{0}%</>的治疗效果提升，最多提升<shuzhi>{1}%</>持续<shuzhi>{2}</>秒
Desc.LocalizedString: Each Guard provides a <shuzhi>{0}%</> damage boost and increases the healing effect by <shuzhi>{0}%</>, up to a maximum of <shuzhi>{1}%</>, for <shuzhi>{2} seconds</>.

Desc.SourceString: 每层冰攻+2500，叠满6层后获得：造成寒冰伤害时降低目标30%移动速度，并冰冻首个目标2秒，冰冻有2秒cd
Desc.LocalizedString: Each stack of frost ATK +2,500. Reach 6 stacks to receive the following effect: Slow the target by 30% when dealing frost damage, and freeze the first target hit for 2 seconds. Freeze has a 2-second cooldown.

Desc.SourceString: 每层冰攻+500，叠满6层后获得：造成寒冰伤害时降低目标30%移动速度，并冰冻首个目标2秒，冰冻有2秒cd
Desc.LocalizedString: Each stack increases frost ATK by 2,500. Reach 6 stacks to receive the following effect: Slow the target by 30% when dealing frost damage, and freeze the first target hit for 2 seconds. Freeze cooldown: 2 seconds.

Desc.SourceString: 每层火攻+2500，叠满6层后获得：造成火焰伤害时附加灼烧，每秒造成目标1%最大生命值火焰伤害，持续30秒
Desc.LocalizedString: Each stack of flame ATK +2,500. Reach 6 stacks to receive the following effect: Inflict burn when dealing flame attacks and deal flame damage that equals 1% of the target's Max HP every second. Last for 30 seconds.

Desc.SourceString: 每层火攻+500，叠满6层后获得：造成火焰伤害时附加灼烧，每秒造成目标1%最大生命值火焰伤害，持续30秒
Desc.LocalizedString: Each stack increases flame ATK by 500. Reach 6 stacks to receive the following effect: Inflict burn when dealing flame attacks and deal flame damage that equals 1% of the target's Max HP every second. Lasts for 30 seconds.

Desc.SourceString: 每层物攻+2500，叠满6层后获得：造成物理伤害时使目标受到的伤害提升60%
Desc.LocalizedString: Each stack of physical ATK +2,500. Reach 6 stacks to receive the following effect: Increase damage by 60% when dealing physical damage.

Desc.SourceString: 每层物攻+500，叠满6层后获得：造成物理伤害时使目标受到的伤害提升60%
Desc.LocalizedString: Each stack increases physical ATK by 2,500. Reach 6 stacks to receive the following effect: Increase damage by 60% when dealing physical damage.

Desc.SourceString: 每层雷攻+2500，叠满6层后获得：造成雷电伤害时如果目标生命低于30%，立马斩杀目标
Desc.LocalizedString: Each stack of volt ATK +2,500. Reach 6 stacks to receive the following effect: Instantly defeat the target when dealing volt damage if the target's HP is lower than 30%.

Desc.SourceString: 每层雷攻+500，叠满6层后获得：造成雷电伤害时如果目标生命低于30%，立马斩杀目标
Desc.LocalizedString: Each volt ATK +500 and reach 6 stacks to receive the following effect: Instantly defeat the target when dealing volt damage if the target's HP is lower than 30%.

Desc.SourceString: 被石化中，持续3秒
Desc.LocalizedString: Petrified for 3 seconds.

This damage boost is removed after using <shuzhi>Flash Rider</>. Cooldown: <shuzhi>{2}</> seconds. While a Shield is active, final damage received is reduced by <shuzhi>{3}%</>.

Desc.LocalizedString: When landing any hit with <shuzhi>Rumble</>, it deals damage to nearby targets equal to <shuzhi>{0}%</> of altered ATK plus <shuzhi>{1}%</> of the Wanderer's Max HP plus <shuzhi>{2}%</> of the sum of all the Wanderer's resistance types plus <shuzhi>{3}%</> of crit. This effect can be triggered up to 1 time every <shuzhi>1.5</> seconds. Explosive Energy damage counts as normal attack damage. If there is <shuzhi>1</> volt/frost/physical/flame weapon of any kind equipped, Explosive Energy damage is increased to <shuzhi>{4}</> times. In addition, Explosive Energy damage is not affected by any damage boost effects except from titan equipment's rare stats, and won't trigger additional attack effects.

When an enemy inflicted with <shuzhi>Static</> is hit by <shuzhi>Magnetic Tempest</>, it enters the Amplification state for <shuzhi>{3}</> seconds, taking <shuzhi>250%</> damage every second (this is counted as skill damage). When <shuzhi>Fortitude Resonance</> is triggered, increase the Wanderer's crit rate by <shuzhi>{1}%</> and decrease nearby enemies' crit resistance by <shuzhi>{2}%</>. This set effect works in the off-hand slot, and only the set with the highest star rating will take effect.
